commandLog.note: Only local account/simulation projections, the static provider catalog, and passive runtime/domain reads were observed; no provider connect/probe/refresh, account mutation, credential entry, Live authorization, Gateway, or financial action ran.

limitations: Only the built-in Local Paper variant was directly rendered. Alpaca Paper, Trading 212 Demo/Live, Binance Testnet/Live, and Bitget Demo/Live were not activated or read; real provider integrations remain skipped/open.
K2-K5 provide separate synthetic failure/recovery projections, not the complete E2 provider/environment matrix or real account data.
The USD 100000 balance is simulation state, not provider truth. In Pies is unavailable and effective availability is not computed in this simulation projection.
External HTTP, browser console warnings/errors, and page errors were not instrumented in this direct CUA replay.
Native VoiceOver, full S02, broader S33, and provider lifecycle remain open; E2 remains IN_PROGRESS.
